entries.text: I woke up today and struggled to get out of bed . When I left my bed , I was extremely tired and lethargic and wanted to get back in it . I had to go to college , so I pushed through anyway . I was tired when I arrived at my first class , and was late due to my aforementioned struggle to get out of bed .

I stayed up until 3 A . M . yesterday because I had too much caffeine but feel okay today . I am anxious because I have to do my English Midterm today . I also need to brush my teeth and dreading it . I don ' t really want to do anything ever .

I am currently feeling like I am a wet dish rag , to say the least . I literally didn ' t do anything today except masturbate which made me feel like a failure . I would say that I am not feeling bad , but not feeling good .

I went to counseling today to discuss my issues and felt like I could tackle them . I had a very pleasant morning and felt better than usual . I had a good enjoyable lunch too , it was a cheeseburger ! Nothing will stop me today .

I did not complete my math homework yesterday that I had a week to do and felt like a useless failure . I did get out of bed today at a reasonable time , and math class was slightly interesting , so I guess I ' m happy . Slightly joyous , even .

I just finished my Javascript Exam and am confident I got 100 % so I feel accomplished ! I am feeling quite tired and lazy though . I have to do my math homework . I don ' t feel as useless as I did this morning .

My headlights on my car was not working which made me scared . I have to hit the center console on the car in order to get it to work , which made me anxious and frightened . I felt like a failure today because I didn ' t go to math class .
